sources.citation: Ferriyan, Thamrin, Takeda, and Murai, HIKARI-2021
sources.collection_environment: Real benign/background traffic plus encrypted synthetic attack traffic; aggregate FlowMeter CSV published by the authors.
sources.capture_dates: 2021 collection; individual published PCAP names span April-May 2021; aggregate CSV does not expose a trustworthy per-row timestamp.

available: directional payload and header byte totals

sources.timestamp_quality: Unavailable in the aggregate CSV; Schema B is prohibited for this source.
known_limitations: Attack traffic is synthetic while benign/background traffic is real.
Protocol missingness may identify this dataset and must be measured by the origin diagnostic.
Published FlowMeter semantics differ from CICFlowMeter and AegisFlow runtime fields.
The binary Label column is an auxiliary label and must never enter features.
No row-random split is permitted; source/capture grouping must be reconstructed or this source may only serve cross-environment testing.

sources.publisher: Canadian Institute for Cybersecurity, University of New Brunswick
sources.license: Redistribution requires citation and a link to the official UNB page.
sources.citation: Sharafaldin, Lashkari, and Ghorbani; CSE-CIC-IDS2018 official dataset page
sources.collection_environment: AWS-based victim network with CICFlowMeter-V3 processed flows; separate daily capture from the frozen final file.
sources.timestamp_quality: 31,855 distinct non-missing timestamp strings; adapter parsing and chronology quality require the full quality report.
known_limitations: Same broad testbed family as the frozen 2018-03-01 CSE report, but a distinct source object and capture day.
Published processed CSV omits endpoints, so Schema B is prohibited.
The attack label is misspelled Infilteration at source and maps to infiltration.
Development use is permitted, but the frozen 2018-03-01 report remains final-only and cannot guide choices.
